title: Reject a stale story parent and identify the expected heads
preconditions: Create checkout r1, append r2 via AddCriterion safe, and retain a writer input based on r1.

steps.action: Try to append criterion clear as r3 using stale r1 parent.
Submit a complete story revision against the old parent set through story revise and inspect the error and public history.
steps.expected_result: The expected current head set is identified, no revision is created, and r2 stays current.

expected_result: A writer must reread current heads before changing a history it no longer owns.
